hypothesis_provenance.economic_rationale: Value premium via earnings-to-price. China A-share evidence (Liu-Stambaugh-Yuan 'Size and Value in China', the CH-3 three-factor model) finds EP (earnings-to-price) is the dominant value factor in China and SUBSUMES book-to-market once the smallest roughly 30% shell stocks are removed; the value premium concentrates in larger, non-shell names, which a top-500 large-cap main-board universe targets. Classic value evidence (Basu earnings-yield; Fama-French HML) plus this China-specific shell-stock correction motivate testing EP as a standalone large-cap value factor, a distinct factor family from the prior quality (pure-quality, cash_conversion) and risk (low_volatility) tests.

frozen_design.hypothesis_text: In a PIT A-share main-board top-500 large-cap universe (reusing the reviewed circ_mv materialization, the 000043 exclusion, and the reviewed full-main-board PIT income fundamentals + restatement-ambiguity exclusion list), ep_value (each name's trailing-twelve-month net income attributable to parent divided by its PIT circulating market cap as of each as-of date, an externally-motivated earnings-to-price value signal) produces positive cost-adjusted excess versus CSI300 over a 504-trading-day hold, surviving HAC-t, cohort, sub-period, concentration, and PIT-hygiene gates (the statistical-alpha-clue tier). Tradeability additionally requires the strategy's rolling-overlapping-portfolio relative-NAV drawdown versus CSI300 to be no worse than -15% (the tradeable-candidate tier), the same frozen bar used by the prior large-cap tests. EP value is motivated by external China value-premium literature (CH-3: EP is the dominant China value factor and subsumes book-to-market in large/non-shell names); it is NOT derived from an in-sample diagnostic of a prior run and is a distinct value-factor family from the prior quality / low-volatility tests, but it is still a single 2018-2025 in-sample-period test and, being the FIFTH program-level large-cap factor tested, even a positive result is a research clue with elevated multiple-testing risk pending forward-live evidence. Names with non-positive trailing-twelve-month earnings are excluded from EP scoring (the D(EP<0) separation), not bottom-ranked. If the single primary cell fails the statistical-alpha-clue gates, large-cap ep_value is falsified under this frozen design.

sub_period_robustness.rationale: 504d holds need a complete forward exit, so late entries (about 2024 onward) cannot form 504d cohorts; split the valid 504d-forming entry cohorts at their median into two equal halves, not by natural calendar years.

risk_gate.relative_drawdown_threshold_rationale: frozen before observing ep_value's NAV; -0.15 is a pre-committed bound on the relative (excess) equity curve, the same bar used by the prior large-cap tests, not tuned to this factor; because the benchmark is the same-schedule CSI300 tranche portfolio, this drawdown isolates stock selection from benchmark-path mechanics.

required_output_diagnostics: Report the one primary cell and its two-tier verdict: statistical-alpha-clue gates separately from the tradeable-candidate relative-NAV-drawdown gate.
Report the full-sample HAC t-stat and each sub-period half's mean excess and HAC t-stat; both halves' mean excess must be positive for the alpha-clue tier.
Report the rolling-overlapping-portfolio relative-NAV (strategy / CSI300) max drawdown and, as diagnostics only, the absolute strategy NAV max drawdown.
Report CSI300 primary and CSI1000 diagnostic without requiring both benchmarks for the alpha-clue label.
Report 504d primary and 252d diagnostic forward horizons; the 252d horizon cannot rescue a primary failure.
Report book_to_market and cash_flow_to_price as diagnostics, and the EP-vs-book_to_market comparison (per the CH-3 subsumption claim); no diagnostic factor can define alpha or rescue the primary.

Report the EP definition as applied: the trailing-twelve-month net-income rollover, the PIT circ_mv denominator, and the count of names excluded each month for non-positive TTM earnings; confirm earnings rows are PIT (ann_date <= as_of) and restatement-excluded.
Report the months excluded from cohort formation for insufficient EP earnings coverage and confirm they are disjoint from the primary cohort as-of set.
Report top-500 PIT market-cap coverage, marginal industry-neutral coverage, and marginal size-neutral quintile coverage for cohort-forming months, and top-count-by-month.
Report the reviewed 000043.SZ / 20191129 data-quality exclusion and confirm the signal universe drops it and backfills the next main-board name by circ_mv before scoring.
Report yearly contribution, name concentration, and tail excess.
Report restatement-exclusion application count and abort if the exclusion list is missing or unapplied.
Report no raw rows, endpoint results, request URL, or secret in any tracked summary.

statistical_alpha_clue: A future reviewed run may label large-cap ep_value as a research-only statistical alpha clue only if the single primary cell is positive net of costs versus CSI300, has HAC t-stat >= 2.0, at least 48 monthly cohorts, both sub-period halves with positive mean excess, and passes name / year concentration and PIT-hygiene gates.
The statistical-alpha-clue tier does not require the relative-NAV-drawdown gate; it is a statistical finding only.
tradeable_candidate_research_only: A statistical alpha clue is additionally labeled a research-only tradeable candidate only if the rolling-overlapping-portfolio relative-NAV (strategy / CSI300) max drawdown is no worse than -15%.
If the alpha-clue tier passes but the relative-NAV-drawdown gate fails, the result is a statistical alpha clue but NOT a tradeable candidate.
Even a tradeable-candidate label is research-only and cannot authorize production, ship-gate evidence, or full-size manual use.
falsified: If the primary cell fails any statistical-alpha-clue gate, large-cap ep_value is falsified under this frozen design.

Do not rescue a failed primary cell from CSI1000, 252d, non-neutral, cap-weighted, diagnostic factors, an alternative earnings basis, an alternative denominator, threshold, horizon, or benchmark changes.
diagnostics_policy: CSI1000, 252d, non-neutral, cap-weighted, book_to_market, cash_flow_to_price, and the absolute-NAV drawdown are reporting diagnostics only.
Diagnostics may inform a later new preregistration, but only through a new reviewed ledger update and user approval.
provenance_caveat: ep_value is externally literature-motivated and is NOT derived from an in-sample diagnostic of a prior run, so it does not carry cash_conversion's in-sample-factor-selection bias; this is a cleaner provenance, and EP is a distinct value-factor family from the prior quality and low-volatility tests.

It is nonetheless tested on a single historical period (2018-2025) and is the FIFTH program-level large-cap factor tested (after full-main-board, pure-quality, cash_conversion, and low_volatility); the singleton ledger and a new reviewed preregistration bound but do not eliminate accumulating program-level multiple testing, so even a passing in-sample result is weak evidence.
Real validation requires the unchanged forward-live ship gate; an in-sample pass is a research clue only.

next_steps: Independent review (now Codex) must validate this preregistration, schema, ledger, tests, and docs before any signal-search work.

After review PASS and commit, a separate signal-search runner slice may be implemented that reuses the vetted measurement chain, the reviewed top-500 universe, and the reviewed full-main-board PIT income fundamentals + restatement exclusion list to compute EP, and adds the rolling-overlapping-portfolio relative-NAV drawdown gate.
The signal-search runner execution still requires its own independent review, commit, and a separate user execute; it spends the new singleton ledger exactly once.
No signal-search runner execution, new data fetch, provider call, DataHub work, production claim, ship-gate claim, or full-size use is authorized by this artifact.
limitations: This artifact registers a design only; it executes no signal search and fetches no data.

ep_value is externally literature-motivated rather than in-sample-diagnostic-derived, so it avoids cash_conversion's factor-selection caveat, but it is still tested on a single 2018-2025 historical period and a positive result is research-only pending forward-live evidence.
It is the fifth program-level large-cap factor tested; accumulating multiple testing means even a passing in-sample result is weak, and a new singleton ledger bounds but does not eliminate this risk.

EP uses circulating market cap (circ_mv), the materialized universe-selection field, as the denominator rather than total market cap; on names with large restricted-share blocks this is an earnings-to-free-float yield rather than earnings-to-total-equity yield, a deliberate no-new-fetch choice noted as a caveat.

Names with non-positive trailing-twelve-month earnings are excluded from EP scoring (the D(EP<0) separation); this is a frozen, pre-committed rule, but it means the EP percentile is over profitable large-caps only.
Statistical power is limited: 504d holds over 2018-2025 give only a few non-overlapping windows, so the HAC t-stat rests on a short effective sample.
Industry neutralization is effectively SW-L1 (sector) level on the top-500 because SW-L2 groups rarely reach the minimum count.
The relative-NAV-drawdown threshold is a pre-committed bound, not an optimized value, and gates only the tradeable-candidate label, not the alpha-clue verdict.
A positive future backtest remains research-only until the unchanged project ship gate, including at least 12 months of forward-live evidence, is satisfied.
